name: print-social-black-history-museum-poster-3d-illustrated-woman-with-tablet
title: AI-generated Black History Month museum poster: a stylised woman with a tablet touring illustrated exhibits (garbled headline text)
whatItIs: A warm orange 3D-illustrated poster of a woman in a teal shirt holding a tablet, walking through a museum with paintings, sculptures and screens on the walls; the headline and body copy are AI-generated and read as nonsensical text.
whatItMeans: Immersive in concept — a virtual museum tour brings history content to life spatially — but the garbled AI text shows why generated headlines still need real typesetting and copy.
techniques: Illustrate a subject moving through a scene of framed exhibits.
Use warm lighting to unify a gallery of varied objects.
Hold a tablet as a device linking the physical exhibit to digital content.
bestFor: Mood reference for museum and exhibition illustration
Educational campaign visuals (redo text before use)

vocabulary.definition: A digitally illustrated or rendered exhibition space.
Artwork that places a character within a fully realised setting.
